jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One INDIVIDUAL full-body Nam Đế illustration based exactly on the master concept reference. Bald peaceful elderly Chinese Buddhist monk, long white brows and beard, saffron and gold cloth robes, dark brown underrobe, wooden prayer beads, simple cloth shoes. One hand behind back, other holds precise pointing index finger with tiny concentrated golden light. Premium detailed chibi wuxia pixel art with dark warm outline and upper-left light, elevated orthographic three-quarter overworld perspective. Full body visible with generous margins, sparse subtle gold aura, true transparent background. No armor, weapons, text, collage, scenery, portal or minions.

Premium detailed chibi wuxia pixel sprite art, elevated orthographic top-down three-quarter overworld. Bald elderly Chinese monk Nam Đế, peaceful wrinkled face, long white eyebrows and long white beard, saffron-gold robe over dark brown cloth, large wooden prayer beads, cloth shoes, no weapons or armor. Match master concept identity; compact big head and body proportions like the production sprites, readable ~56px standing height at final export, dark warm-brown outline, crisp authored pixel clusters, highlights upper left. TRUE transparent background, no checker pattern, no labels, no grid lines, no scenery, no floor/shadow. This is an actual animation source sheet, not concept art. EXACT four equal columns, equally spaced rows; one complete independent full-body cel per cell, generous transparent gutters. Same body size in all cells, planted root centered within cell; each row is four genuinely DIFFERENT drawn sequential animation poses, not shifted copies. All limbs, beard, robes fully within cell. All 28 cels face down (front facing viewer, top of head and front robe visible). Layout EXACTLY 4 columns x 7 rows. Row1 idle: breathing, bead and sleeve micro-motion. Row2 walking: four-phase planted left step, passing, right step, passing; robe hem follows legs. Row3 Phật Môn Chưởng heavy palm: gather hand, draw arm back, full wide palm thrust, recoil. Row4 Nhất Dương Chỉ charge: raise one finger, extend elbow, fingertip brightens, concentrated small point. Row5 Nhất Dương Chỉ release: precise forward point anticipation, decisive extension, fingertip flash, recovery; keep large beam separate. Row6 Liên Hoàn Nhất Dương Chỉ rapid finger: four distinct alternating quick finger jabs with small fingertip glints. Row7 Đại Lý Phong Huyệt: deliberate precise low pointing strike gather, aim, release, recover. No large VFX baked into body.
